about.title: Built for Hong Kong families
intro: I moved to Chung Hom Kok and couldn't find any activities there.
Other families nearby were in the same situation, so I started Siu Tin Dei.

summary.heading: What is Siu Tin Dei
paragraphs: Siu Tin Dei (小天地) is a website that lists children's classes, camps, and places to play in Hong Kong. Each activity page shows the ages, the times, the price, and how to contact the organiser.
It lists activities in {placeFull} today, and adds new areas one district at a time.
Siu Tin Dei is run by LX Software, a business registered in Hong Kong.

items.question: How do I join an activity?
items.answer: Open the activity's page and contact the organiser with the details shown there. The page lists the ages, the weekly times, and the price.

items.question: Which areas does Siu Tin Dei cover?
items.answer: Activities in {placeFull} today. New areas are added one district at a time.

items.question: I run a class. Can I manage my own page?
items.answer: Yes. Get in touch and you can manage your own page and describe what you offer in your own words.

items.question: Who runs Siu Tin Dei?
items.answer: LX Software, a business registered in Hong Kong. The privacy policy and terms of use explain how the site handles your data.

sections.heading: Starting in Stanley
paragraphs: So I started in Stanley. It's close to home, and it's a place families already go. I wanted this for my own family, and for other families trying to find activities from the same spot.

sections.heading: Southern District first
paragraphs: Next is the rest of Southern District: Repulse Bay, Ap Lei Chau, and the neighbourhoods around them. After that, the whole of Hong Kong.

sections.heading: A voice for small businesses
paragraphs: I couldn't find a reliable search directory that was accurate, complete, and covered small businesses. The small places get missed, or the details are wrong. I want to give those businesses a voice.

sections.heading: You can manage your own page
paragraphs: If you run a small business, you can manage your own page. You know what you offer. The page should say it your way.

sections.heading: How listings are checked
paragraphs: Most listings start from public sources: organisers' own websites and pages, and public lists. Then I check them one organiser at a time, by visiting or by talking to the organiser. A checked listing carries the Parent-Verified badge. A listing without the badge has not been checked yet.

sections.heading: Free for families and organisers
paragraphs: Siu Tin Dei is free to use, and listing a class, camp, or place to play is free.

sections.heading: Get in touch
paragraphs: If something is wrong, if you want to control your page, or if you have a suggestion, get in touch.
